question: Which iconic Bharatanatyam dancer and actress, known for her work in over 230 films, was honoured with the Padma Bhushan in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shobana Chandrakumar Pillai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Shobana Chandrakumar Pillai** is a renowned Bharatanatyam dancer and actress, known for her contributions to Indian classical dance and cinema.
 
• She has performed in numerous Bharatanatyam productions globally, earning accolades for her mastery of the art form.
 
• Shobana has acted in over 230 films across various languages, including Malayalam, Tamil, Telugu, and Hindi.
 
• She was honoured with the prestigious **Padma Bhushan in 2025** for her exceptional contributions to performing arts.
 
• Shobana is also a recipient of the **National Film Award for Best Actress**, further establishing her as a versatile artist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vyjayanthimala Bali:**

 
 
• Vyjayanthimala is a celebrated actress and Bharatanatyam dancer, recognized as one of the first female superstars of Indian cinema.
 
• She is known for her performances in films like **Devdas, Madhumati, and Sangam**.
 
• Vyjayanthimala is also a recipient of the **Padma Bhushan**, awarded for her contributions to Indian cinema and dance.
 
• She played a pivotal role in popularizing Bharatanatyam on the global stage.
 
 
 
• **Mallika Sarabhai:**
 
 
• Mallika Sarabhai is a renowned classical dancer, theatre artist, and activist.
 
• She is the daughter of the legendary scientist Vikram Sarabhai and the classical dancer Mrinalini Sarabhai.
 
• Mallika is known for using art as a medium for social change, often addressing issues like gender inequality and environmental conservation.
 
• She is a recipient of numerous awards, including the **Padma Bhushan**, for her contributions to Indian classical dance and activism.
 
 
 
• **Alarmel Valli:**
 
 
• Alarmel Valli is one of the foremost practitioners of Bharatanatyam, known for her lyrical and expressive style.
 
• She has performed extensively across the globe and has received several accolades for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• Valli is a recipient of prestigious awards like the **Padma Shri** and **Padma Bhushan**.
 
• Her performances are characterized by intricate footwork, emotive expressions, and innovative choreography.
 
 
 
• **Bharatanatyam:**
 
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, originating from Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is deeply rooted in Hindu temple dances and is characterized by intricate gestures, expressions, and rhythmic movements.
 
• The dance form is known for its storytelling aspect, often depicting themes from Indian mythology.
 
• Bharatanatyam is widely recognized as a spiritual and artistic tradition, requiring years of rigorous training and dedication.
